invariants.pyCode:
def AckLevelMonotonic():
    return after.ack_level >= before.ack_level

# main liveness property: every confirmed task is eventually acked-or-expired
# and the ack level eventually passes every confirmed task (reader never gets
# stuck — in particular not on a batch of entirely expired tasks)

    remaining = len([t for t in confirmed if t not in ever_acked and t not in expired])
    behind = len([t for t in confirmed if t > ack_level])
    return remaining == 0 and behind == 0

frontMatter.yaml:
# Milestone 3: M2 + expired tasks.
# A task sitting in the DB may expire at any time (nondeterministic,
# monotonic — no clock is modeled). Expired tasks read from the DB are passed
# through mergeTasksLocked and added as pre-acked (nil) entries so they
# advance readLevel/ackLevel and get GC'd (fix 0b372d5e). A task that expires
# while already loaded is simply completed by the acker (in the real system
# the matcher drops it at dispatch time and completeTask runs), so it needs
# no extra handling here.
options:
  max_actions: 100
  max_concurrent_actions: 2
  crash_on_yield: false
deadlock_detection: false   # "all written tasks acked" is a valid final state
liveness: strict
